review_evidence: README identifies Loom as a Lean framework for foundational multi-modal verifiers with weakest-precondition generation, executable semantics, nondeterminism, and sample verifiers with automated and interactive proofs.

The Loom modules formalize monad algebras, weakest-precondition generation, nondeterministic semantics, specification monads and tactics; CaseStudies modules instantiate these abstractions in verified examples.
The case-study and tactic material carries concrete formal semantics and proofs, so no FILTER-004 lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain Loom's verifier framework, semantics, generated-proof infrastructure, and formal case studies.
